selected_linear_root_port_endpoint_check.evidence_limit: Focused finite verification of the 66 recorded port-chain witnesses and their endpoint scope, not a re-audit of BRANCH's general chain theorem or lower-bound proof.
selected_linear_root_port_endpoint_check.helper_identity_note: Own helpers are fresh locals at their creating copy; four are also passed to unused ray-port slots. This is allowed: universal lifting was checked with all three incoming ports fixed, and each step's selected outgoing carrier follows the recorded cycle.
selected_linear_root_port_endpoint_check.interpretation: Every cycle begins at an incoming root port numbered 0..2, and each out slot is the next incoming port. Every cycle includes a bond step whose outgoing carrier is a fresh own local. Since any root port may be chosen, rotate the initial cycle phase so that its step at C_s ends at that fresh local of C_s. The recorded existence construction therefore has the required root-port endpoint; it is not restricted to starting at a root local.
